sections.value: #152 0c01b1b8cfac84d9e83704bb955e9180365a9a4e BLOCK C32(1): absent caller context accepts claimed holder B, preserves From=B and arbitrary body to recipient C; receiver injects '[pij from B]' and FYIs also preserve B. Unbound audit qualification does not relabel the recipient envelope. A state-only assertion may be accepted under C32; arbitrary delivery as B is not. Refusal-downgrade repair C32(2) and atomic answer/audit F006 C32(3) are closed. No stronger origin requirement introduced. Reject context-free correlated delivery or separate no-delivery state mutation. CI green; source-only, no tests/probes. Verdict: security/outputs/2026-11/08-verdict-pr-152-0c01b1b.dd.json.
